# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 19 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-18 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level18_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 19 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-18 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-18, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-20+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-19 "Special" column reads "Channel energy 10d6"
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror, byte-for-byte agreement): base attack bonus genuinely
# RISES to +14 (19 * 3 / 4 = 14, up from 13 at level 18); good Fortitude/Will
# STAY at +11 (19 / 2 + 2 = 11, an integer-division coincidence with level
# 18); poor Reflex STAYS at +6 (19 / 3 = 6, an integer-division coincidence
# with level 18). Channel Energy's die count genuinely RISES to 10d6
# ((19 + 1) / 2 = 10, up from 9d6 at level 18) via the same pre-existing
# formula, not re-derived. The flat domain spell slot count STAYS 9 (a
# level-19 cleric still casts only up to 9th-level cleric spells, the
# highest cleric spell level in PF1). The Good domain's Touch of Good sacred
# bonus STAYS at 9 (19 / 2 = 9, an integer-division coincidence with level
# 18) via the same pre-existing formula, not re-derived.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level19

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:19
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12

ability=charisma:14

choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
